objective: Save all existing work, archive the old workspace under legecy, and establish the independent agent engineering foundation
acceptance: The original workspace and Git metadata have a verified recoverable snapshot
Original non-Git entries are preserved under legecy, with protected config handling recorded
Ignored and private data remains ignored and is excluded from knowledge indexing
New guidance and commands have no runtime dependency on the archived implementation
Knowledge tools have behavior tests for stale data and scope boundaries
Configured model and skill state is validated separately from current-session activation
